IQAC
Govt. Model Women College, Bilasipara, is a premier institution established by the Government of Assam to disseminate higher education among the women in the Bilasipara area and throughout Assam. Although the college was initially established for women, from the 2024-25 academic year onwards, the institution has received permission for co-education, allowing both boys and ...
Read More
Mission
1. To encourage a healthy academic atmosphere for the advancement of superior education.
2. To create a community of highly educated women capable of handling the present while also molding the future.
3. To integrate higher education into the social environment through community engagement and equitable development.
4. To foster developments in organizing, teaching, and evaluation in order to accomplish greater levels of excellence.
5. To raise awareness among students about reaching out to the marginalized and impoverished.
6. Encourage female students to push themselves for self-sufficiency and entrepreneurial endeavors.
Vision
To contribute to the development of a compassionate, equitable, empowered, and humane culture.
The college's aim is to make our students' ambitions a reality and, in the process, nurture them into educated and cognizant individuals capable of facing the challenges of living in an evolving environment and responding appropriately.
From Principal's Desk
Dr. Biswajit Biswas
Principal i/c and Secretary
As the In-Charge Principal of Govt. Model Women College, Bilasipara, I extend a warm welcome to all prospective students. Our institution, though newly established in 2023 and currently undergoing infrastructure development, is dedicated to providing a comprehensive education in the field of Arts under the esteemed Gauhati University (GU-FYUGP).
Our complete infrastructure is still under construction, the facilities pertaining to classrooms and other academic activities have already been completed. Rest assured that the remaining work is currently underway. We anticipate that it will be finished shortly.
We believe in nurturing not just academic prowess, but also in fostering essential life skills that will pave the way for your future success. Our dedicated faculty and staff are here to guide and support you throughout your journey at our college...
